label: Yud-Tes Kislev
title: A gift you have to tell about: Shabbos
summary: A shorter shiur given on Yud-Tes Kislev before a farbrengen. The Gemara teaches that one who gives a gift must let the recipient know, and Hashem's good gift of Shabbos. Moshe's shining face, the extra neshamah that comes with Shabbos, and the eruv tavshilin made for a whole town.

chapters.title: A shorter shiur for Yud-Tes Kislev
Moshe didn't know his face was shining
Telling someone you gave them a gift
An eruv tavshilin for the whole town
The blind man who knew the Mishnah

key_ideas: One who gives a gift must let the recipient know, because a gift is meant to bring closeness.
Shabbos is Hashem's hidden gift; its full reward has not been revealed.
An extra neshamah comes with Shabbos and leaves when it ends.
An eruv tavshilin can be made on behalf of everyone in a town.

sources.title: Reb Nachum of Chernobyl and the Berditchever on telling the recipient
